question: Do winner-industry diffusion and industry rank rotation form replicating next-block leadership dynamics after fixed current-state controls?
research_role: outcome-blind temporal process after representation and external compression

availability.response_available_at: completed t+5 exchange-session close at 15:00 Asia/Shanghai
availability.entry_predictor_use: forbidden; this experiment creates no action

responses.next_block_rank_rotation5: rank_rotation coordinate shifted exactly five sessions earlier within view/denominator; value at t+5 compares industry ranks at t and t+5
responses.future_winner_diffusion_change5: winner_diffusion coordinate at t+5 minus value at t within view/denominator

temporal_blocks.membership_rule: predictor date and response date must both fall inside the block

estimation.primary: partial Spearman by rank-residualizing predictor and response on fixed controls with intercept
estimation.relative_groups: two denominators pooled across non-ALL_A or all rank views
estimation.nonoverlap: phase-zero every fifth valid predictor row within each original view/denominator and temporal block
estimation.sign: not prespecified; must replicate after discovery

gates.no_rescue: No edge, sign, coordinate, block, phase, view, denominator, control deletion, or favorable subset can replace a failed exact temporal edge.

prohibited_fields: future market, industry, or stock return
future stock rank, selected industry return, or stock-selection outcome
strategy membership, signal, admission, trade, P&L, MFE, MAE, exit, duration, or outcome class
MKT-INDRS-001 failed roles, equal-industry participation, or stock/industry residual dispersion as direct predictors
claim_boundary: Passing establishes only a replicating outcome-blind leadership-state dynamic, not market/stock return prediction, industry timing, habitat fitness, causality, execution, or a strategy rule.
